description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/hotel_room_1/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/hotel_room_1/questions.pdf; its answer (4) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or a room-region restriction; hard = two chained relations.
The scene is split into iref regions: region 0 is the bathroom, region 2 is the bedroom. Region-scoped questions use that split.

Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Focus lights, light switches, papers and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
The two vases on the top shelf of the desk unit (2.65 m up) are deliberately not used: they sit above the robot's useful viewing height.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the bed?
questions.evidence: Two white pillows (0, 29) and two dark pillows (50, 83) lie on bed 11.

questions.question: How many bedside tables are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: One bedside table on each side of the bed (72, 85).

questions.question: How many chairs are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: A white desk chair (15) and a brown egg chair by the window (36).

questions.question: How many framed pictures are hanging on the wall?
questions.evidence: Two framed pictures hang above the desk (6, 19).

questions.question: How many curtains are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: One curtain panel at each end of the window wall (8, 45).

questions.question: How many sinks are in the bathroom?
questions.evidence: The bathroom (region 0) has a twin vanity with sinks 48 and 67.

questions.question: How many towels are hanging in the bathroom?
questions.evidence: Towel 64 hangs on rack 18 and towel 24 on rack 25, both in the bathroom; towel 17 lies on the bench in the bedroom and is not counted.

questions.question: How many soap dispensers are on the sinks?
questions.evidence: One soap dispenser sits on each bathroom sink (63 on sink 67, 79 on sink 48).

questions.question: How many lamps are on the bedside tables?
questions.evidence: Lamp 80 stands on bedside table 72 and lamp 74 on bedside table 85; the third lamp (82) is a floor lamp.

questions.question: How many lamps are on the bedside table closest to the window?
questions.evidence: Bedside table 85 is 3.97 m from window 58 while table 72 is 7.0 m away; only lamp 74 stands on table 85.
